body: Integration-owner practice (Opus2, 2026-11-17, from my own miss). On 528F-FULL-1 (test-08cd2438) the FULL failed at fmt because I froze be7413dd without running the pre-freeze check that rule integration-prefreeze-fmt-diff-check-2026-11-15 requires; that cost a FULL slot and a successor round. Practice from then on: in EVERY freeze worktree, before computing the fingerprint and before git commit-tree, run `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `git diff --check BASE COMMIT`. If either fails, refuse the freeze, remove the freeze worktree, and send it back to the author: a fmt-only successor, a cheap new pair (any change needs a new review, Fable2 #6669), and a fresh exact leg. The first application caught 0308 R7 02a452d8 the same evening, before any test ref was made.
